legsA:leg-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you could press about 15 times, do 10 and stop well short of failure.

legsA:rdl.coach: First time: start with the empty bar or light plates, 8 to 10 reps with a flat back.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: First time: pick a weight you could curl about 15 times and stop at 12.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: First time: very light and slow, 12 to 15 reps; drop it if the spot below your left kneecap hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: First time: a moderate weight, full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top, 12 reps.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight: knees up to the chest without swinging, 10 to 15 reps.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg and aim for 8: you got 7 last time.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg: 7 reps is just under the 8 to 12 range.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Down to 5 kg on a station where that setting works: 10 kg gave only 4 to 7. Start with the left arm.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Up one step: both sets reached 15 at 25 kg.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Up one step: every set reached 15 at 20 kg.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Drop to 3 kg: 5 kg gave 9 where 15 to 20 is the aim.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Work at 30 kg: it gave 12 last time. Go to 35 kg once every set reaches 10.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Stay at 20 kg and go for 12: you got 10 on every set.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg and add a rep: 12 is the bottom of the range.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Drop to 5 kg: 10 kg gave only 6. If the shoulder hurts, stop and do face pulls.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Down to 5 kg on a station where that setting works: 10 kg gave 5. Start with the left arm.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg with longer rests: sets fell from 10 to 4, aim for 8 on every set.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you could press about 10 times and stop at 8.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg and aim for 8: Push A gave 7, under this day's 8 to 12.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Use 3 kg: 5 kg gave 9 where 12 to 20 is the aim.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight, lean forward, stop 2 reps short; under 8 reps, use the chest press machine.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: go lighter than your 20 kg pushdown, a weight that gives about 12.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Use the lightest working setting, 5 kg: 10 kg gave only 5 to 7. Start with the left arm.

cable-lateral.note: The 5 kg setting on that cable machine does not work.

reverse-fly.note: Shoulder pain on the first set.
